owner: Existing CharacterHero aggregate and player_heroes row

schema.columns: six bigint raw_skill_N, six bigint raw_skill_id_N, skill_seed_policy_id text; fixed-size domain arrays [6]int64, nonnegative raw values/IDs, no invented growth/max-level rule
schema.policy_binding: I7C2A_V1_RAW_SKILL_SEED_V1; immutable seed decision identity retained with owner fact and receipt
schema.backfill: Owned atomic migration from schema00047; stage nullable new fields, fill only absent facts, validate complete fixed shape, make NOT NULL. Preserve explicit zero/nondefault facts; malformed partial facts must fail/report rather than be overwritten as a missing whole facet. No external V1 save importer is authorized.
schema.version: Increment Hero state_version once for introduced canonical facet, never change partner_id/root allocator/base progression. Capture one migration transaction instant for changed updated_at; it is migration metadata, not gameplay clock settlement. Immutable saved operation/media outcomes retain original owner versions. Upgrade must be an exclusive/controlled migration before new traffic; no runtime double backfill.
schema.down: Existing forward migration policy governs; do not claim destructive column removal is a safe recovery after writes. Backup/restore qualified upgrade fixture under inherited migration gates.

ports.store: Extend existing InsertHero/read/list/lock/scan queries. Dedicated SaveHeroSkillChoiceTx uses owner-version CAS and changes selected ID only; other SaveHeroState methods preserve all raw fields.
ports.content: Extend existing immutable ContentRegistry generator/bundle/store with narrow Hero skill-ID/choice catalog and exact seed/choice policy identity; validate references against current partner/super_partner/skill and approved V1 mappings. No alternate content registry, Buff/stat compiler or database in this stage. Reuse compiler source parsers. Preserve partner vs partner1 provenance; do not hardcode the three-choice profile as all current stock truth.
ports.observation: Typed RawHeroSkillsTx returns canonical six arrays + Hero version/policy. A content-qualified ID observation separately resolves ordinary IDs or special override/defaults at the caller-pinned revision. Showcase may expose raw qualification while finalStats remains unavailable until3B.
ports.inventory: Reuse I5 typed Tx-owned LockStackTx/owner observation or narrow read gate adapter to it; do not debit books, write inventory SQL in Character, or introduce a new inventory owner.

transactions.root: Existing generation.TimedRunner, actor lifecycle fence and player root acquisition, existing global owner/resource ordering, lock Hero and relevant I5 book state under the same transaction; choose captured decision instant after required locks under inherited time contract.
transactions.replay: Fingerprint partner_id,skill_index,skill_item with stable policy/content binding. Same operation key/different payload conflicts; receipt returns the six IDs at that operation, not newer live state. Use inherited unknown-COMMIT receipt adjudication; no guessed success.
transactions.same_choice: Idempotent same-value choice preserves state_version if unchanged, but success still validates owned Hero/book at first execution and records a replayable outcome; preserve book quantity.
transactions.actor_scope: Every mutation/read binds actor PlayerID and typed owned Hero; foreign ID, retired/invalid actor, stale time/version/content and unsupported identity fail closed.

receipt_compatibility.acquisition_v1: Existing acquisitionReceipt has no skills. Keep old bytes unchanged. Explicit legacy schema decoder materializes authorized six-one/six-zero snapshot for the historical response before Hero.Validate, never reads live Hero to patch replay.
receipt_compatibility.acquisition_v2: New receipt schema/version includes fixed raw arrays/policy snapshot with base identity/version. Missing/partial fields in v2 are invalid, not silently defaulted.
receipt_compatibility.other_receipts: Audit existing receipt structs that serialize or reconstruct Hero after domain changes; preserve old snapshots with schema-specific decoding and exact wire outputs. Do not bulk rewrite receipt rows.
receipt_compatibility.source_response: MID2144 returns skill_ids only as caller expects; stock roster returns canonical skills/skill_ids. Do not wire derived default skill IDs into raw override array.

implementation_batch: Forward-only owner/content migration and domain/query/store/codegen extension
Atomic seed in common creation path and legacy/new receipt compatibility
Source-bound content/typed raw reader and stock projection extension
Bounded V1-preserving MID2144 owner composition/dispatch and receipt recovery
Affected tests, frozen candidate, portable R2 qualification and independent source/contract review
excluded: MID53/39 general skill-level progression and point purchase/recovery; explicit future expansion
Product implementation in this research/design turn
size: MEDIUM_PLUS: one existing aggregate, one forward migration/content section, three creation paths and one bounded choice command; no additional split justified
future_amendment_rule: If implementation reveals contradictory policy/content or a missing critical owner gate, checkpoint it and reconcile under frozen C1; no silent policy replacement.
